en.title: Minimum Possible Value of Function
en.description:
Given a sequence X, find an integer k that minimizes Σ|X[i]−(k+i+1)|, and output the minimum value.

The standard input/output format and any supplementary ranges on this site are as stated in this problem.
en.input: n (1≤n≤200000), and the next line has n integers X[i] (1≤X[i]≤10^9).
en.output: Output the minimum value of the function as an integer.
en.explanation: Let y[i]=X[i]−(i+1); then the objective is Σ|y[i]−k|, and the median of y is an optimal k.
hints: Let y[i]=X[i]−(i+1); then the objective is Σ|y[i]−k|, and the median of y is an optimal k.
